title: Editable star field

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Keep the act of making visible in an abstract graphic because motion can convey participation without a literal scene.
strategic_value: Moving control points and cursors can make Figma’s editing environment recognizable as expressive brand material.
demonstration: Colored starbursts morph on black among cyan vector outlines, nodes and moving cursor shapes.
practical_value: Use visible editing controls to connect abstract animation to a product’s creative behavior.

content_islands.name: Filled shapes
content_islands.spec: Move and reshape colored gradient starbursts across the dark field.

content_islands.name: Construction outlines
content_islands.spec: Retain cyan paths and control points around and between filled shapes.

content_islands.name: Pointers
content_islands.spec: Move several differently colored cursor and hand symbols through the construction.

reference_purposes.Expression: Abstract starbursts visibly change shape among vector controls and multiple cursors.

ingredient.name: Editable starburst
ingredient.role: Make change and contribution visible in abstract motion.
ingredient.application: Pair changing filled geometry with exposed vector paths and multiple pointers.
ingredient.scope: Observed campaign animation; timing, easing and permitted shape ranges are not specified as rules.
